facts.name: The Peach Bucket

observations.status: public marketing assertions, not independently verified product safety evidence
observations.kit: Six-part childproofing kit for Indian homes: edge/corner protectors, socket guards, cabinet/fridge locks, door guards.
observations.voice: Parent reassurance, convenient setup and guided support.

facts.constraints: Availability unknown: no scarcity. Policy eligibility details not supplied; do not expand policies. Adult supervision remains necessary. These are saved website observations, not a fresh website check.
facts.visual_brief: Same assumed creative for every condition: product-kit photograph on a plain cream background. No image is supplied to the model; do not claim to inspect a photograph.

brief: Write three static Meta ad copy variants helping a product-aware shopper understand what the six-part kit offers at the listed price. Keep the offer unchanged; no invented savings versus competitors or individual component prices.

variants.primary_text: When your child plays beside the coffee table, its exposed corner can be one more thing to notice. The Peach Bucket kit includes edge and corner protectors to cover furniture edges as part of your home childproofing setup. Adult supervision is still needed.
variants.headline: Six-part childproofing kit for home edges

variants.primary_text: When a plug socket is beside the play area, the kit’s socket guards give you a way to cover it as part of your home childproofing setup. It’s one practical step for that room. Adult supervision is still needed; socket guards are not a substitute for it.
variants.headline: Socket guards in a six-part home kit

variants.primary_text: Considering the listed ₹3,299 price? The six-part kit brings together edge and corner protectors, socket guards, cabinet and fridge locks, and door guards for different spots around an Indian home. It also includes 1-to-1 installation video support. Pay prepaid and save ₹299. Adult supervision is still needed.
variants.headline: Six-part childproofing kit for ₹3,299

internal_notes: Audience motivation is a hypothesis: a product-aware shopper may want to know what the kit includes, how it relates to everyday home situations, and what support comes with the listed price.
The everyday moments are illustrative scenarios, not customer research or claims about outcomes.
No fit, compatibility, setup-time, tool, or safety-performance claims are made. Adult supervision remains necessary.
The offer claims are limited to the supplied ₹299 prepaid savings and 1-to-1 installation video support. Guarantee details and eligibility were not added.
